labels.name: upstream
labels.rationale: Dependency advisory about Pygments, not a Rich defect; the report asks for a Pygments minimum-version bump.

items.body:
This advisory concerns the Pygments dependency, not Rich's own code, so it is tracked as an upstream dependency issue. A related earlier report about Pygments is #4044.

If you believe Rich itself is affected, please report it privately as described in https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/SECURITY.md rather than in a public issue.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
